integrity: An analytic proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic checks are supplied; finite comparisons are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires mirror-palindromic positive longitudinal weights and uniform positive rung weights. The first simultaneous-failure cutoff holds only for unit longitudinal weights and two specified endpoint input placements. Historical literature comparison includes inaccessible specialized double-layer work; no independent validation has been performed.
title: Parity-selective resonance and the first simultaneous two-input control failure on weighted ladders
